scenes.title: The View from the Wanderer
scenes.rationale: The statue ascent, religious discussion, and terrain survey share one vantage point and the immediate goal of choosing where to go.
scenes.overview: Survey the ruins and divine monuments; choose the nearest tower.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party reaches a ruined manor occupied by dragonets.

scenes.title: Dice and a Promise of Secrecy
scenes.rationale: Scouting, introduction, gambling, and payment negotiations are one continuous attempt to win Ghesh’s cooperation.
scenes.overview: Kenzo gambles with Ghesh and promises a circlet for an introduction and silence.
scenes.transitionToNext: Ghesh leads Kenzo toward Megren’s tower.

scenes.title: Ghesh, Megren, and the Missing Jade
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, the journey with Ghesh and the visit to Megren form one scene: Ghesh’s introduction leads directly to learning where the jade went, and the visit concludes with his payment.
scenes.overview: Travel with Ghesh, meet Megren, learn about the jade and lair, and pay the promised circlet.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party leaves its hosts and regroups privately.

scenes.title: Seeking the Elder in the Forest
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, the strategy discussion and forest journey form one scene: the decision to seek the elder leads into the crossing, the pilgrim road, and the corrupted memory pool.
scenes.overview: Choose to seek the elder, cross the island, enter the forest, and pass a corrupted memory pool.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party stops to scout magically and rest.

scenes.title: A Messenger and a Scrying
scenes.rationale: Both beats describe the same halt and short rest; the scrying is narrated retrospectively.
scenes.overview: Scout the temples, send a lynx messenger, and see an elder building a trap.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party resumes walking and reaches an elven memorial.

scenes.title: The Forest Remembers
scenes.rationale: The memorial vision, conversation with the forest, shared memory, and stone examination all explore the island’s past during one visit.
scenes.overview: Experience remembered lives and learn about the island’s ancient refuge and memorials.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party leaves the forest and reaches the summit temples.

scenes.title: Meeting Dimitaur
scenes.rationale: The trap, hidden voice, jade reveal, and ensuing conversation are one continuous encounter that changes from suspicion to trust and ends with rest.
scenes.overview: Disarm the temple trap, befriend Dimitaur, discuss Rai and the dragon, and rest overnight.
